text: Addendum No. 1 dated August 14, 2026: from September 16, 2026, the unit price of Monthly Cleaning Service is changed to IDR 8,208,000.00 per unit.
Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank CIMB Niaga, number 83078932117, in the name of Sterling Hygiene Group.
Late payment accrues interest of 2% per month on the overdue amount.
